title: Homotopy colimit of truncations
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$, and $\mathcal G^\bullet$ a cochain complex of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. The canonical map from the homotopy colimit of the good truncations $\operatorname{hocolim}_{N\to+\infty}\tau_{\le N}\mathcal G^\bullet$ to $\mathcal G^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Moreover, a filtered colimit of quasi-isomorphisms of complexes of $\mathcal O$-modules is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Lemma 06YS (successive truncations and filtered colimits in the K-flat resolution construction)

proof.text: Use the proved source-library truncLEMapOfLE and truncLEMapOfLE_ι to construct the natural-number diagram D with D(n) = tau_{<=n} K and its cocone of truncation inclusions. Apply [lem-pc-complex-hocolim-colimit] to D. Extensionality on the coproduct summands identifies telescopeShift R D with the required identity-minus-shift endomorphism.

For each integer degree i, choose the natural number i.toNat + 1. At every subsequent index n the inclusion (tau_{<=n} K)^i -> K^i is an isomorphism, by the proved source-library isIso_ιTruncLE_f and i < n. The source-library isColimitOfIsEventuallyConstant gives the evaluated colimit cocone; HomologicalComplex.isColimitOfEval makes the truncation-inclusion cocone a colimit of complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. The unique colimit isomorphism e : colimit D ~= K sends each structure map to its truncation inclusion. Compose the telescope comparison g with e.hom. Coproduct extensionality checks its unshifted component, associativity of HomComplex cochains checks its zero shifted component, and composition with an isomorphism preserves quasi-isomorphisms [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules].

Apply [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian] directly to the given small ringed site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Only its Grothendieck abelian assertion is used, giving exact filtered colimits; no K-injective resolutions are needed. The proved source-library HomologicalComplex.isStableUnderColimitsOfShape_quasiIso instance and MorphismProperty.colimMap then show that the filtered colimit of the componentwise quasi-isomorphisms is a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. This instance expresses that exact colimits commute with homology and hence preserve the homology isomorphisms.

lean.statement: theorem quasiIso_hocolim_truncLE_and_filtered_colimit {S : Type u} [Category.{u} S] {J : GrothendieckTopology S} (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ) : (let E : ℕ → CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ := fun n => K.truncLE (n : ℤ) let A := ∐ E ∃ t : ∀ n : ℕ, E n ⟶ E (n + 1), (∀ n, t n ≫ K.ιTruncLE ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = K.ιTruncLE (n : ℤ)) ∧ ∃ f : mappingCone (𝟙 A - Sigma.desc (fun n => t n ≫ Sigma.ι E (n + 1))) ⟶ K, mappingCone.inr _ ≫ f = Sigma.desc (fun n : ℕ => (K.ιTruncLE (n : ℤ) : E n ⟶ K)) ∧ (mappingCone.inl _).comp (HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom f) (add_zero _) = 0 ∧ QuasiIso f) ∧ (∀ (I : Type u) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I] (F G : I ⥤ CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj R)) ℤ) (α : F ⟶ G), (∀ i : I, QuasiIso (α.app i)) → QuasiIso (colim.map α))
